audit.whatIsWrong: The chart gives Pantheon four of the last four rows (levels 4-5, first item, 2+ items) on a 56.3% Cho'Gath win rate over 389 games, while the matchup's own prose says levels 4-5 'even the lane', level 6 is 'the takeover', first item is where 'you out-trade him', and the late game is 'fully yours'. The packet chart agrees with the prose.
audit.why: Pantheon is an early bully with a 13s point-click dash-stun and no scaling; Cho'Gath is a Feast-stacking tank. Nothing in either kit supports Pantheon owning the two-item row.
audit.corrected: Pantheon / Pantheon / Pantheon / Skill / Cho'Gath / Cho'Gath / Cho'Gath, proposed as one atomic group across win[0..6] and phases[0..6].side+rating. Deviates from the packet only at levels 4-5, where the prose says 'even' rather than Cho'Gath-favoured.

audit.whatIsWrong: Phase text called Heartsteel Cho'Gath's spike and listed 'levels 2-3 (full pattern)' as his window, which is exactly Pantheon's peak.
audit.why: Cho'Gath's spikes here are the first HP component (Comet Spear poke stops sticking) and level 6 (Feast as an execute). Pantheon's are level 2-3 and then nothing except Grand Starfall's 180s global roam.

audit.whatIsWrong: Two ability facts are wrong across seven fields. (1) Pantheon's W is called 'Aegis' or 'Aegis Assault' and described as a point-click stun in spikes[0].text, whys[1], early, mid, wants.foe[1] and wants.you[0]. His W is Shield Vault — the point-click dash-stun. Aegis Assault is his E, a 22s channel that blocks frontal damage. (2) whys[0], whys[4], spikes[1].text and mid credit Pantheon with an 'auto-blocking passive'. His passive is Mortal Will, which empowers every few spells or attacks; the blocking is on Aegis Assault (E), not the passive.
audit.why: Two different abilities are being merged into one, and the counterplay differs: Shield Vault is point-click with nothing to dodge (you bait its 13s cooldown), while Aegis Assault is a channel any crowd control ends — a Rupture knockup cancels it outright. A player told his passive blocks autos will also mis-time Feast.
audit.corrected: W renamed Shield Vault throughout, the block reattributed to Aegis Assault (E) with its 22s cooldown, and the empowerment reattributed to Mortal Will. report[5].t now carries the channel-cancel interaction.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns was placeholder text with no numbers.
audit.why: Shield Vault 13s at rank 1, Aegis Assault 22s at rank 1 and Grand Starfall 180s at rank 1 are the three clocks; the 22s one is the punishing one because a cancelled channel costs him the whole cooldown.
audit.corrected: All three written in, with the channel caveat.

audit.why: Packet flagged 'Use Grand Starfall' in wants.foe[2] as a suspect name. It is the correct name preceded by a verb — false positive.

notes: MIRROR CONFLICT, deliberate. audits/top/pantheon__chogath.json was already written and made no level-chart edits, so it left Pantheon's side reading Pantheon / Pantheon / Pantheon / Pantheon / Skill / Pantheon / Pantheon. That chart contradicts a 56.3% Cho'Gath win rate over 389 games, the packet chart, and both champions' own prose, so I corrected my side rather than copy the error. tools/mirror-fix.js will see a disagreement on rows 4-7 — it must resolve toward this version, not the Pantheon page's. I reused the mirror's ability findings rather than re-deriving them (Aegis Assault is a channel any CC ends, Rupture is a knockup not a line, Carnivore is the reason poke does not stick) and stated them from Cho'Gath's side. I did NOT change diff (HARD) or diffRating (7.5/10) even though a 56.3% win rate argues they are wrong, because the Pantheon page carries the inverse label and I did not want to introduce a second mirror disagreement on top of the chart one — see questionsForUser. NOT ASSERTED: whether Feral Scream's silence prevents Pantheon from recasting Grand Starfall mid-flight, and whether Aegis Assault's frontal invulnerability applies to Feast (Riot says 'invulnerable to damage from the front' and Feast is true damage from point-blank, but the directionality rule is not in the data).
